title: The Cloud and the Three Causes of Storm
description: A cloud is the mediating state in which trapped archonic powers are made visible against the likeness of the Virgin of Light. Three causes — cloud-from-fire, cloud-from-water, cloud-from-wind — by which falsity is exposed (lightning, thunder, hail), struck by angels at the appointed hour, captured in tree and flesh, and finally either lifted upward in its first icon or cast down to the seven fossae outside the great sea at the feet of the Omophoros.
